Do the selected Congo and Angola witnesses show one simultaneous independence transition? Separate transitions

claims.text: Which two acquired city/event witnesses establish different independence transitions? FRUS’s editorial account places Congo independence at Léopoldville on 30 June 1960. Luanda’s modern provincial account places the 11 November 1975 proclamation at Largo da Independência. These are separately mediated witnesses, not proof of universal assent or peaceful outcomes.

Belgian/Congolese and Portuguese/Angolan actors remain distinct. Lumumba’s coercion testimony is attributed, not all Congolese opinion. A modern Luanda commemoration is not the literal 1975 act or proof of peaceful/unanimous transition; no Cabinda title conclusion follows.
